'''Hell projectors''' were a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weaponry.

==History==
Several such devices were installed onboard the ''[[Wennis]]'' and had the ability to destroy entire continents.

==Behind the scenes==
The term "hell projector" was likely a euphemism, given the context it was used in.
